text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I spotted Jungle Pocket 
walking around the academy grounds, 
constantly looking around with a restless 
expression.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Suzuka~ Suzukaaa~. ...She ain't 
here either.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
She left her horseshoe maintenance gear 
behind on the track. If you spot her, 
could you give her a shout?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since I had no pressing matters, I walked 
around for a while looking for Silence 
Suzuka, but—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Ran into you again. Judging by 
that look, you haven't seen Suzuka yet 
either, huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Are you looking for Suzuka?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hm? Oh. You know where she is?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No. However, I have a good idea. On days 
like today when the tracks are crowded, 
she is likely running along the riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh, for real?! Thanks! I'll head over 
there right away!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Wait. ...Could you give this to her? There 
are sandwiches inside.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I bought them intending to have them for 
my own lunch, but... if Suzuka has no need 
for them, you may eat them yourself.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...? Well, sure, no problem.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curious about the intention behind the 
sandwiches Air Groove had handed over, I 
decided to tag along with Jungle Pocket.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oh! There's Suzuka! Lucky, didn't even 
have to go all the way to the riverbank!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Here, your horseshoe maintenance kit— and 
also, a snack from Air Groove! Said 
they're sandwiches!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...From Air Groove? These?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, fufufufu. I see... how curious.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I was running along the riverbank just 
a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
But for some reason today, I got hungrier 
than usual... So I decided to pack it up 
early.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
You saved me... Once I eat this, I feel 
like I can run again today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Pokke. I need to thank Air 
Groove later, too.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Did ya hear that? ...Ain't that wild? 
She's practically psychic! Just how in 
sync are those two anyway?
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's just because they've been 
together so long.

Maybe it's just because they've been 
together so long.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that's what true companions are, 
huh. I get it now...

And so, that matter was settled... Though 
as we parted ways, Jungle Pocket wore a 
thoughtful expression on her face.

Sometime after that, I caught sight of 
Jungle Pocket at an arcade downtown.

text_block_list.name: Pokke's Former Racing Buddy
text_block_list.text:
—Oh! I knew you'd be here! Heyyy, 
Pokke-san!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ohh!? Long time no see, oi! You come here 
to hang out too?!

text_block_list.name: Pokke's Former Racing Buddy
text_block_list.text:
Nah, didn't really have any business here. 
How do I put it... when I walked past the 
place, I just felt this 'spark', ya know?

text_block_list.name: Pokke's Former Racing Buddy
text_block_list.text:
Like, 'Wait, could Pokke-san be here right 
now?' And boom, hit the jackpot!

text_block_list.name: Pokke's Former Racing Buddy
text_block_list.text: W-What's up?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Nah, nothing. Just made me realize that 
companions are connected deep down, 
totally beyond words or logic.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Even with folks where it feels like words 
don't quite get through... That's just 
fine the way it is. For real.

text_block_list.name: Pokke's Former Racing Buddy
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, as expected of you! You always say 
the coolest stuff!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Now let's have some fun! You 
went outta your way to come see me, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Pokke's Former Racing Buddy
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! You'll forever be our idol, 
Pokke-san! I bet it was your aura I was 
picking up on!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heh, don't go flattering me like that. 
Well... to me, you guys will always be my 
crew too!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright! How about an impromptu street 
race today! Been itching to run with you 
guys again!
